blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — Residents, commuters and motorists are now using the newly completed Bailey bridge in Santa, Ilocos Sur, which provides a temporary crossing following the closure of the Calungbuyan Bridge due to damage caused by continuous rains. The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Ilocos Sur 2nd District Engineering Office completed the Bailey bridge on Wednesday, Sept. 16, allowing residents from Barangays Rancho, Dammay, Calungbuyan, Oribi and Casiber to travel safely to the Santa town proper. The temporary bridge also serves as an alternative route for transporting agricultural and other local products to markets and commercial […]...
